verdict.rationale: Canva documents a broad programmatic surface. The Connect REST APIs cover assets, designs, comments, autofill, resize and export, and an official MCP server adds design generation, editing, discovery, export and asset management. Nothing in the evidence claims UI parity, and some features are plan-gated and rate-limited (e.g. resize-design is Pro and above at 20 req/min). Missing for 10: any documented claim or evidence of full UI-to-API parity, a direct element-level editing API outside the in-editor Apps SDK and natural-language MCP edits, a publicly reachable OpenAPI spec (probed paths 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: You can use the REST APIs to build web apps that create and sync assets, designs, comments, and more.
Apply targeted modifications to existing designs through natural language commands
Generate exports in multiple formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, PPTX, MP4, and so on) and resize designs for different channels
Upload and organize assets, manage folders, and access brand kits and templates
